accident_report: V1 is traveling in Lane 3 at 60 km/h. V2 is in Lane 2, traveling at 50 km/h and plans to change lanes into Lane 3. V3 is in Lane 4, traveling at 65 km/h, with V1 15 meters behind it. As V1 travels in Lane 3, V2 suddenly changes lanes into Lane 3 without signaling properly. To avoid a collision with V2, V1 swerves sharply to the left into Lane 4. However, due to a sudden oversteer, V1 loses control and collides with V3, which is traveling in Lane 4. The impact causes V1 to spin out of control and skid until it hits the barrier wall on the left side of Lane 4. The outcome is that V1 collides with V3 and hits the barrier wall on the left side of the road. V2 completes the lane change into Lane 3 and may stop or continue driving. V3 might be damaged and could stop or pull over to the shoulder.
